name: Dynamic Entropy Singular Value Decomposition (Dynamic Entropy SVD) Compress
description: Dynamic Entropy Singular Value Decomposition (Dynamic Entropy SVD) Compressor.  Implements singular entropy computation over empirical layer activation covariances: $$H(\Sigma_l) = -\sum_{i=1}^{d} p_i \ln(p_i), \quad p_i = \frac{\sigma_i}{\sum_j \sigma_j}$$ Dynamically budgets layer ranks $r_l \in [r_{\min}, r_{\max}]$ proportional to singular entropy, subject to global rank or parameter budgets,

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
